Instant Pot FAIL
Just tried
 to make our first meal in our brand new Instant Pot Duo Crisp + Air Fryer and it was a complete failure. Was trying to make an eye round roast and the meat never got above 82° F. Browned the meat & sautéd onions & garlic as per instructions. Set it up to pressure cook for 4 minutes. It said ON/HI for a little while then 4 minute counter/high (with pressure indicator up). Counted down, then it went to just keep warm (pressure cook no longer lit up) for 30 minutes. Opened instant pot and checked with digital meat thermometer. Only 82°F. What went wrong?
